programmes.d: Juliette plans a surprise birthday party for Deacon; as Teddy and Rayna's divorce moves forward, speculation about Rayna's fidelity ramps up; Scarlett is charmed by Gunnar's brother.

Rayna tries to set the record straight about her failed marriage during an appearance on Katie Couric's talk show; Maddie tells a lie that leads to dangerous consequences; Deacon is drawn to a pretty veterinarian.

Rayna brings her kids and sister on tour, but doesn't like the effect Juliette is having on her girls; Juliette starts to look at Dante differently; Deacon reconsiders life on the road; a handsome new neighbor befriends Gunnar and Scarlett.
Zoe's mom (Jobeth Williams) surprises her with a visit. Vivian (Lauren Bittner) wants to meet Wade's dad. AnnaBeth gets an interesting request from the Belles.
Zoe is secretly thrilled that her mom (Jobeth Williams) takes her on as a client. Brick enlists Lavon's help to throw Lemon a welcome home party. Claudia Lee appears as Magnolia.
Lavon organizes BlueBell's Renaissance Faire and decides to use Lemon's two suitors as the main event. Wade is excited about his upcoming anniversary with Vivian (Lauren Bittner).
Lemon convinces George to help her with a business venture. Brick sees an opportunity to become BlueBell's Man of the Year, but he soon discovers he has some tough competition.
George and Lemon try avoiding each other, but it is hard now that they're business partners. AnnaBeth gets to know Davis (Barry Watson), Brick's patient with constant ailments.
Zoe and Lemon find some common ground and turn to each other for some much-needed girlfriend advice. Wade becomes suspicious of Vivian's (Lauren Bittner) ex's true intentions.
Zoe finds herself in the middle of Wade and Vivian's (Lauren Bittner) relationship, putting her in an awkward position. George agrees to go on a date with a Bible School teacher.
Lemon and Wade decide to play hooky from their respective problems. Brick tries to help Wanda (Mallory Moye) and Tom (Ross Philips) cope with infertility issues.
Wade's dad (Christopher Curry) asks Zoe for help with his love life, but Wade advises her against it. Lavon finds himself in competition with his rival, Mayor Gainey (Alan Autry).
Zoe makes a grand gesture and Wade must make a tough decision about his future with the Rammer Jammer and BlueBell. Lavon and George meet their hero (Reggie Hayes).
In the season premiere, Zoe struggles to get Wade to notice her romantic gestures. Meanwhile, George and Lavon are on the outs after realizing they are both interested in Lemon.
Zoe does her best to focus on work instead of Wade. Lavon and George begrudgingly work together to get the real scoop on Lemon's new boyfriend, Henry (Ian Anthony Dale).
Zoe and Wade make progress on their relationship. Lemon enlists AnnaBeth and Crickett (Brandi Burkhardt) to crash George's parents' lake house. George and Lavon make big decisions.
Lavon organizes a BlueBell talent show. But when Shelby (Laura Bell Bundy) suddenly becomes ill before her performance, it is a mystery the entire town tries to solve.
To keep Zoe from getting stressed, Wade lies to her about how great the Rammer Jammer is doing. Lemon and Lavon try to move on with their lives, but it's easier said than done.
Zoe and Wade learn the gender of their baby and realize that they are not ready for parenthood. Lavon must talk to his nemesis over in Fillmore, but he needs AnnaBeth's help.

When Liam asks Rayna to run away with him and finish her album, Deacon has an unexpected reaction; Jolene questions Dante's loyalty; Teddy confronts Peggy about the leaks.
Edgehill Records throws a party for Rayna and Juliette when they are both nominated for CMA awards; Juliette is faced with new challenges; Scarlett worries about Gunnar.

Dante sends Juliette a blackmail demand. Juliette asks Avery to help with her new song. Rayna has Deacon over for dinner with the girls and Teddy objects. He serves Rayna a restraining order and Rayna seeks Lamar's advice.
Juliette finds a letter from her mother; Deacon confronts Rayna about a secret; Brad Paisley performs with Rayna and Deacon; Gunnar tries to win Scarlett's heart back.
Deacon and Rayna try to heal their wounds after their traumatic crash.
